summary: Verified BET bugfix patch (commit 0a5ca15 / HEAD 6a2516b5): (1) _user_says_house routing override in bet_frame/hook.py and (2) _with_heartbeat + HEARTBEAT_S/STALE_MIN stall detection in bet_core/assistant_tool.py. Ran the targeted unit test file plus regression suites. Also smoke-tested backend API endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patch verified. 35/35 pytest tests passed (3 new in test_bet_routing_heartbeat.py covering _user_says_house keyword detection FR/PT/EN, STALE_MIN<=3min and HEARTBEAT_S*2<STALE_MIN*60 invariant, and _with_heartbeat update_one call count during/after coro; plus 2 assistant_read_memory + 30 commercial_offer regressions). GET /api/ -> 200 and GET /api/openapi.json -> 200. No frontend testing performed (patch is backend-only per request). bet_agent/ folder untouched. No DB mutations.
rca of the issue: Bug1 RCA: BET routing engine was overriding explicit user house choice; mitigated by _user_says_house keyword matcher that respects user intent. Bug2 RCA: BET study jobs stuck in 'running' after backend restart; mitigated by periodic heartbeat writes (HEARTBEAT_S=10s) and STALE_MIN=3min threshold enabling detection of dead jobs.
